purpose: Route always-on persistent agent-memory requests here, and keep session-query, context-pack-builder, and continuous-learning on their own prompts.

cases.prompt: read persistent agent memory at the start of this session
record this lasting fact in nexus-memory
wake persistent memory and remember this decision in the memory store
merge the pending memory range in nexus-memory
search my past sessions for when we debugged the auth bug
build a context pack from our session digests
mint an instinct from these session corrections
